integrity_statement: The theorem is supported by an explicit structural proof and a separately executable consistency checker. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula is for structured concatenations and precisely three first full-alphabet morphic ranks, not every iterate or every rich word. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace proof. Possible unindexed equivalent specializations of general arch theory remain a priority risk.
title: Three shortest absent subsequences in a rich-word morphic family
